complexity.notes: Initializing best_buy to 100 relies on the stated constraint prices[i] <= 100, which is guaranteed, but float('inf') would be more idiomatic and constraint-independent. Iterating with 'for price in prices' would also be cleaner than indexing.
complexity.summary: Single pass tracking the minimum price seen so far (best_buy) and the maximum profit of selling at each day, returning the best profit found. Since best_profit starts at 0, the no-transaction case is handled automatically.
